verdict.rationale: Inngest publishes a REST API reference at api-docs.inngest.com covering events, function runs, and environments, so a reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or has runnable examples, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the common paths on the main site. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of the reference's usability.
